text:
sasha: heads-up: nightly eval flagged a big spike in 'cohort A' corruption for model rwd-open-v2-int4. lots of blanks / 'error' tokens. eval-bot shows 42% failure - overnight alert.

_eval-bot_: ALERT: nightly-suite/2026-03-20 cohort-corruption threshold breached. failing tests: fewshot-summarize, extractive-qna. failures=42/100; median token-length drop. logs: https://internal.redwood/eval/3129991111 :rotating_light:

maya: on it — grabbing sample generations and history. @aj want to pair on quick reproducer?

aj: yep. assigning to me for initial triage. severity: high (impact: internal eval pipeline + prod baseline config).

oncall-ml: noticed dedicated int8 bringup yesterday on canary pool around 03:10 UTC. routing fallback may have sent int4 variants to more traffic. checking rollout logs.

simon: posting 3 bad samples here:
```
PROMPT: Summarize: "Q1 results"
OUTPUT: <err><err><err>

PROMPT: Extract answer: "Where is the meeting?"
OUTPUT: 

PROMPT: Few-shot: give steps
OUTPUT: [NULL]
```

maya: those look like KV-cache truncation artifacts — repeated <err> tokens and blank lines. suspect kvcache index mismatch after quantized kernel change.

aj: saving reproducer: run eval locally: ./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rwd-open-v2-int4 --cohort A --seed 42
observed: blank outputs after 256 tokens

sasha: priority: rollback int4 kernel on canary and trigger rerun. @infra oncall escalate?

devex-bot: deploybot: rollback job started for job id jd-4821. ETA ~6m.

oncall-ml: confirm rollback in progress; also kicking off nightly eval rerun for only affected cohort; will post results.

maya: if rerun still fails, next step: run eval on float16 build and compare diffs -> tag owners: @sasha (product), @aj (eng-ml), @infra

aj: :thumbsup: I'll update the incident doc and create a follow-up ticket w/ reproducer and stack traces.
